search_text: published ZDI-24-882 ZDI-CAN-20007 VMware vCenter Server Appliance License Server Uncontrolled Memory Allocation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2024-06-25 CVE-2024-37087 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-37087 5.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L ['VMware'] ['vCenter Server Appliance'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of VMware vCenter Server Appliance. title: VMware vCenter Server Appliance License Server Uncontrolled Memory Allocation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of VMware vCenter Server Appliance. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the License Server. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an uncontrolled memory allocation. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
